base.note: Built off the FIRST one — the zip Gary gave us (arc_serverless_v10_complete.zip). The zip is the authority for the base engine; this package is the zip plus the offline conversion.

description: ARC v10 spatial signal engine as an offline world map — multi-device tracking, RF visualization, sensor mesh, triangulated location, path history. No server, no network.
name: Offline Worldmap

offline.note: Default mode needs zero network: grid tiles are drawn locally, GPS defaults to none, the simulator is opt-in. Local tiles are a {z}/{x}/{y}.png directory the user points at.

sourceRepo.note: Companion repo for this plugin — the fetchedAtInstall source. The repo copy and the zip are identical (parent-verified byte-for-byte). If the repo copy ever drifts from the zip, the zip is the authority for the base. Install fetches the repo tarball for the HEAD commit and uses arc_serverless_v10_complete/ inside it; the fetched copy must be this offline build (vendor/ present, no unpkg/openstreetmap references) or the install fails with a clear error.

vendor.note: Vendored at build time from unpkg. Leaflet is BSD-2-Clause (c) Vladimir Agafonkin — license header kept in leaflet.js. No runtime network.
